name: 🥔 Japanese Potato Salad
steps: Boil the potato cubes 15–18 min until a knife slides in with no resistance. Drain and let the steam dry off.
Boil the eggs 8 min for a jammy yolk, then cool under cold running water and peel.
Poach or pan-sear the chicken breast until cooked through (74°C core), then cool and cube.
Whisk the yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, honey and rice vinegar into a smooth dressing.
Fold the warm potato through the dressing and mash roughly half of it — the mashed half is what makes it creamy.
Fold in the chicken, cucumber, spring onion and quartered eggs. Season and chill at least 30 min before eating.
💡 Dress the potato while still warm. Warm starch absorbs dressing; cold potato just gets coated.

name: 🐟 BBQ Salmon with Mango Avocado Salsa
steps: Cook the rice per packet instructions and keep it covered.
Pat the salmon completely dry, then rub with the BBQ seasoning and honey. A dry surface is what lets a crust form instead of steaming.
Toss the mango, avocado, red onion and lime juice with a pinch of salt. Set aside so it mingles while the fish cooks.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in a hot dry non-stick pan 4–5 min until the skin is crisp, then flip for 2–3 min more.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, set the salmon on top and pile over the salsa.
💡 Make the salsa first. Ten minutes of sitting turns mango, lime and onion into something far brighter than the sum of its parts.

name: 🥟 Creamy Chicken & Gnocchi
steps: Sear the diced chicken in a hot dry non-stick pan until golden and just cooked through, then lift it out.
Crisp the gnocchi in the same pan until golden at the edges, picking up the chicken fond.
Add the garlic and spinach and cook about a minute until the spinach wilts.
Take the pan OFF the heat, then stir in the yogurt, parmesan and herbs. Off the heat is the whole trick — direct heat splits yogurt into a grainy mess.
Return the chicken and toss until everything is coated. Season and serve.
💡 Crisping the gnocchi before saucing gives you chewy golden edges that boiling alone never produces.

name: 🥜 Caramelised Beef & Peanut Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles to just under the packet time. Drain, keeping a mugful of the cooking water.
Brown the beef hard in a hot pan with the sesame oil. Leave it undisturbed so it caramelises — stirring too early steams it pale.
Add the garlic and stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey and rice vinegar together, then pour into the pan with a splash of noodle water to make a glossy sauce.
Toss the noodles through until every strand is coated, loosening with more noodle water as needed.
Finish with the chopped peanuts and spring onion.
💡 The starch in the noodle water is what makes the sauce cling instead of clump. Don't pour it all away.

name: 🌶️ Crispy Gochujang Chicken
steps: Cook the rice per packet instructions and keep it covered.
Toss the diced chicken in the cornstarch until lightly coated, then leave it 5 minutes while you mix the sauce. The rest is what makes the coating crisp properly.
Stir the gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar and garlic together in a small bowl.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan with the sesame oil, leaving it undisturbed in places so it turns golden rather than steaming.
Once the chicken is cooked through and crisp, pour in the glaze and toss about a minute until sticky and coating every piece.
Serve over the rice, finished with spring onion and sesame seeds.
💡 Add the glaze only at the end. The sugar in it burns fast — you want it sticky, not scorched.

name: 🍛 Yellow Curry Meatballs
steps: Cook the rice per packet instructions and keep it covered.
Mix the ground chicken with the garlic, ginger, egg white and panko, then roll into small meatballs with damp hands. Don't overwork it — handling makes them dense instead of tender.
Brown the meatballs on all sides in a hot dry non-stick pan, then lift them out. They finish cooking in the sauce.
Add the curry paste to the same pan and fry 1 minute until fragrant, scraping up the browned bits. Blooming the paste in heat is what wakes up the flavour.
Pour in the coconut milk, broth and fish sauce, stir, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the meatballs and simmer 8–10 min until cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Finish with the lime juice and serve over the rice.

name: 🌯 Chicken Shawarma Wrap
steps: Toss the cubed chicken thigh with the shawarma spice, half the lemon juice, the olive oil and a generous pinch of salt. Leave at least 15 min so the seasoning penetrates.
Grate the garlic straight into the yogurt, add the remaining lemon juice and half the parsley, and stir until creamy.
Get a skillet properly hot before the chicken goes in. Cook in a single layer until deeply browned at the edges and cooked through — crowding the pan steams it grey.
Combine the tomato, cucumber, red onion and remaining parsley just before serving so it stays crisp.
Warm the flatbread briefly in a dry skillet, spread the garlic yogurt down the centre, add chicken and salad, and roll tightly.
💡 Thigh over breast here — it stays juicy under the hard char that shawarma needs.

name: 🍝 Spinach Ricotta Chicken Lasagne Roll-Ups
steps: Boil the lasagne sheets until just pliable, then drain and lay them flat so they don't stick together.
Wilt the spinach, cool it, then squeeze out as much water as you can. Wet spinach makes a watery filling.
Combine the chopped chicken, ricotta, spinach, egg white, parmesan, garlic and herbs until evenly mixed.
Spread the filling thinly over each sheet and roll each one up without squeezing the filling out the ends.
Spread a layer of passata across a baking dish, sit the rolls on top seam-side down, then spoon over the rest.
Scatter the mozzarella over the top and bake at 190°C for 20–25 min until bubbling and browned in patches.
Rest 5 minutes before serving, then scatter with parsley.
💡 Keep the cheese on top rather than layered through — you get the browned crust without tripling the fat.

name: 🍅 Chicken Parm with Spicy Honey
steps: Butterfly the chicken breast into a cutlet so it cooks evenly and quickly.
Season it, dip in the egg white, then press firmly into the panko, parmesan, herbs and garlic powder.
Air-fry at 200°C for 10–12 min until deeply golden and cooked through (74°C core). Air-frying gives the crumb its crunch without submerging it in oil.
Warm the passata in an oven-safe pan until bubbling at the edges.
Set the crisp chicken over the sauce, top with mozzarella and return to the heat until it melts and blisters.
Mix the honey with the chilli flakes and spoon over, then finish with torn basil.
💡 Press the crumb on firmly and don't move the cutlet once it's in the basket — that's what keeps the coating attached.

name: 🥪 French Onion Steak Sandwich
steps: Cook the onion low and slow in the olive oil, 15–20 min, until deeply golden, soft and jammy. Rushing this on high heat gives you burnt edges and raw centres, not sweetness.
Stir the yogurt with the horseradish, dijon and lemon juice until smooth.
Season the sirloin and sear in a hot skillet to medium-rare, then rest it before slicing against the grain.
Spread the sauce over the bread, then layer the steak, caramelised onions, gruyère and rocket.
Toast the closed sandwich in a dry skillet, pressing gently, until the bread is crisp and the cheese has just melted.
Rest a minute before cutting so the juices stay in the sandwich rather than on the board.

name: 🥢 Egg Roll in a Bowl
steps: Brown the beef in a hot skillet, breaking it into small crumbles until deeply coloured.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 3–4 min so they soften but keep some bite.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger and garlic until everything is glossy and evenly seasoned.
Fold through most of the spring onion, then spoon into a bowl and scatter with sesame seeds and the rest.
💡 All the flavour of an egg roll with none of the wrapper — this lands around 20g of carbs, so it slots in on a low-carb day without feeling like a compromise.

name: 🌶️ Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta to al dente, reserving a splash of the cooking water before draining.
Toss the chicken with the cajun seasoning and black pepper, then sear in the olive oil until browned at the edges and cooked through.
Add the pepper and garlic, cooking briefly until tender but still slightly crisp.
Lower the heat, stir in the evaporated milk and cream cheese, and let the sauce turn smooth.
Fold in the pasta and chicken, tossing until coated, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Scatter with parsley and plenty of black pepper.
💡 Evaporated milk gives you a cream-textured sauce for a fraction of the fat — it thickens because it's already concentrated, not because of added fat.

name: 🌮 Smash Burger Tacos
steps: Divide the beef across the tortillas and press it into a thin, even layer right to the edges.
Cook beef-side down in a hot non-stick skillet until deeply browned, then flip so the tortilla turns golden and crisp.
Scatter the mozzarella over the hot beef and let it melt before lifting each one out.
Stir the yogurt with the ketchup, mustard and chopped pickles until creamy and tangy.
Add the sliced pepper, drizzle with sauce, and fold while still warm.
💡 Pressing the beef straight onto the tortilla is what makes this eat like a burger — the meat and the tortilla cook as one piece rather than two.

name: 🥩 Balsamic Braised Beef & Butter Bean Mash
steps: Season the beef and braise it with the broth, half the garlic and the rosemary, covered, 75–90 min until fork-tender and easy to shred.
Shred the beef back into its cooking juices, add the balsamic and simmer until everything turns glossy and lightly sticky.
Sear the shallot halves cut-side down until deeply caramelised, then let them soften alongside the beef.
Warm the butter beans with the remaining garlic and a splash of broth, then blend until creamy. Finish with the olive oil, lemon and seasoning.
Spoon in the bean mash, pile over the beef and shallots, then finish with parsley and lemon zest.
💡 The bean mash does the job of potato with a third of the carbs and around 10g of fibre — it is the reason this bowl fills you up.

name: 🍢 Greek Chicken Skewers with Whipped Feta
steps: Coat the chicken in half the yogurt with the lemon, paprika, garlic powder, oregano and black pepper until every piece is covered. Yogurt marinades tenderise as well as season.
Thread onto skewers, keeping the pieces close enough to stay juicy but not packed tight.
Air-fry at 200°C until browned at the edges and cooked through (74°C core), turning midway.
Blend the feta, remaining yogurt and a little lemon juice until smooth, airy and thick enough to spread.
Spread the whipped feta across the plate, scatter over the cucumber and mint, and lay the skewers on top.
Finish with the olive oil.
💡 Around 15g of carbs — a genuinely low-carb dinner that still eats like a proper meal.

name: 🍔 Big Mac Bowl
steps: Toss the potato cubes with the olive oil and black pepper, then roast or air-fry at 200°C until deeply golden and crisp-edged.
Brown the beef in a hot non-stick skillet, breaking it into chunky crumbles until cooked through.
Stir the yogurt with the ketchup, mustard and a spoonful of the pickle liquid until creamy and loose enough to drizzle.
Layer the shredded lettuce with the tomato and pickles, then add the hot beef and potatoes in separate sections.
Spoon the burger sauce across the bowl and scatter with sesame seeds.
💡 All the burger, none of the bun. The yogurt sauce carries the tang that normally comes from mayonnaise.

name: 🐟 Creamy Tuscan Salmon with Rice
steps: Cook the rice per packet instructions and keep it covered.
Pat the salmon completely dry and season with the garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Sear presentation-side down in the olive oil until deeply golden, then lift it out — it will finish in the sauce.
Soften the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes in the same pan, then add the evaporated milk and reduce gently until it coats a spoon.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then take the pan OFF the heat before stirring in the yogurt and lemon juice. Off the heat keeps it silky instead of grainy.
Return the salmon to warm through, then plate over the rice and finish with basil and cracked pepper.

name: 🍲 Chicken, Sweet Potato & Cannellini Soup
steps: Toss the sweet potato and cauliflower with the olive oil, cumin and paprika and roast at 200°C until soft and caramelised, holding a few pieces back for the topping.
Soften the onion in a pot over medium heat until translucent.
Poach the chicken breast in the broth until cooked through, then lift out, shred, and set aside to stir back in at the end.
Add the roasted veg, the cannellini beans and the broth, and simmer 5 minutes to bring it together.
Blend until completely smooth, adding a splash more broth if it is too thick. Blend a minute longer than feels necessary — that is the difference between grainy and silky.
Ladle into bowls and finish with the reserved roasted veg and parsley.
💡 The chicken and cannellini beans together are what make this a meal rather than a starter — the beans bring the fibre, the chicken brings the protein.

name: 🥩 Cottage Cheese Alfredo Steak Rigatoni
steps: Boil the rigatoni until just al dente, reserving a little pasta water before draining.

Blitz the cottage cheese, milk, garlic, parmesan and lemon juice until completely smooth and free of curds. Blending is not optional — unblended cottage cheese stays lumpy no matter how long you warm it.
Season the steak and cook in a lightly oiled hot skillet until browned outside and pink inside. Rest, then slice.
Warm the blended alfredo over low heat, stirring in pasta water until it coats a spoon without becoming heavy.
Fold the rigatoni through the sauce until every piece is glossy.
Plate with the sliced steak alongside, finished with parmesan, cracked pepper and the chilli crisp.

name: 🍗 Smothered Chicken with Mushroom Gravy & Mash
steps: Butterfly the chicken into thin cutlets so they cook fast and evenly.
Season with the garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper, then sear in the olive oil until deeply golden. Remove and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the same pan until browned and their water has cooked off.
Whisk the cornstarch into the COLD broth before it goes near the pan — adding dry starch to hot liquid gives you lumps every time.
Pour into the pan with the thyme and simmer until thick, then return the chicken and coat in the gravy.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with the Greek yogurt and butter.
Char the green beans in a hot dry skillet, then plate everything with extra gravy spooned over.

name: 🥔 Crispy Potato Breakfast Box
steps: Toss the potato cubes with the olive oil, paprika, salt and pepper.
Air-fry at 200°C for 18 min, shaking the basket halfway, until properly crisp. In an oven, roast 20–25 min at 200°C in a single layer and flip once.
While the potatoes cook, brown the turkey in a pan over medium-high heat with the cumin and garlic powder, 6–8 min.
Scramble the eggs low and slow with a splash of milk — creamy beats rubbery, and low heat is the only way to get there.
Build the box: potatoes, turkey, eggs, then the reduced-fat cheddar scattered over while everything is still hot.
Keep the salsa in a separate container so the potatoes don't go soggy.
💡 Reheat the potatoes in an air fryer rather than a microwave — a microwave turns the crisp edges to steam.

name: 🥚 Bake-Once Chicken & Egg Breakfast Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a baking dish with parchment.
Whisk the whole eggs and egg whites with the garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Stir in the chicken, spinach, pepper and onion until evenly distributed — mix properly or the filling all sinks to one end.
Pour into the dish and spread level, then scatter the reduced-fat cheddar over the top.
Bake 30–35 min until a knife in the centre comes out clean.
Cool 10 min before slicing — cutting hot gives you a crumbling mess.
💡 Scales cleanly for the week: set the batch size and the shopping list multiplies the tray for you. Keeps 5 days refrigerated and freezes well.

name: 🥕 Carrot Cake Baked Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, egg, maple syrup, cinnamon and nutmeg together until evenly combined.
Fold in the grated carrot and raisins so the carrot-cake flavour runs through every bite rather than sitting in pockets.
Pour into a ramekin or small oven dish.
Bake at 180°C for about 20 min — it is ready once the top sets and the edges pull away slightly.
Top with the walnuts and puffed quinoa for crunch.
💡 Grate the carrot finely. Thick shreds stay crunchy in the bake instead of softening into it.
💡 Toast the walnuts in a dry pan first — a few minutes deepens their flavour considerably.

name: 🫐 Wild Blueberry Vanilla Kefir Bowl
steps: Simmer half the blueberries with the maple syrup and lemon juice for a few minutes until they burst into a thick, glossy compote.
Stir the vanilla and honey into the kefir and yogurt so the base tastes finished rather than plain.
Spoon the kefir mix into a bowl — a thick base gives the toppings something to sit on.
Swirl the warm compote over one side. The warm-on-cold contrast is what makes this feel like dessert.
Top with the remaining fresh blueberries and the granola.
💡 Add the granola last. Layered in early it loses its crunch to the kefir within minutes.
💡 Frozen wild blueberries work better than fresh for the compote — they break down faster and release more juice.

name: 🍫 Frozen Banana Snickers Bar
steps: Halve the banana lengthways — flat pieces give you a stable base to layer everything onto.
Freeze the banana for 10 minutes before dipping. A cold base sets the chocolate faster and far more neatly.
Spread the peanut butter over the cut side. This is the caramel layer that makes it taste like the candy bar.
Press the chopped peanuts into the peanut butter so they don't roll off when you dip.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil and drizzle over — the oil helps it set into a clean, snappy shell.
Add a pinch of flaky salt right after the chocolate, before the shell hardens.
Freeze on parchment at least an hour until firm.
